subject: statistics: avoid stats meta full load after table analysis (#57756)
summary: Analyze executor now passes the analyzed table/partition physical IDs into the stats cache Update call. StatsCache.Update can restrict the mysql.stats_meta scan via a table_id IN filter, and for these targeted updates it skips advancing the cache’s max stats version (to avoid cascaded reload behavior / missed delta windows), while still updating the analyzed tables’ cached stats. Call sites were updated to the new CacheUpdate API and a test asserts analyze does not move forward the cache version while a normal full Update does.
